question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded Control UI composer modal for long prompts, or continue handling this friction through inline composer sizing and the existing send-shortcut setting?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing composition mode and draft/send workflow rather than repairing a documented broken contract, so automation should not choose the UX direction alone.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Implement a scoped modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Ergonomics
options.body: Keep composition inline and improve long-prompt comfort through sizing, resizing, and the existing shortcut preference instead of adding another mode.

options.title: Decline Modal Direction
options.body: Close the request by maintainer decision if Control UI composition should remain inline-only for now.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Implement a scoped modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They have already reviewed this request and own the adjacent merged send-shortcut direction that shapes the UX tradeoff.
